description: This file contains test scripts for Git operations that involve pushing to repositories, testing hook behavior, especially testing the 'proc-receive' hook absence and failure scenarios during push operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, wraps the test commands for setup and validation.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, wrapping the execution of commands that should fail.
